preconditions.description: The length of the string S is greater than 0 and less than or equal to 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(char in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for char in string)
preconditions.description: The string S contains only uppercase letters from A to Z.

postconditions.expression: output == None or output == 'Stuart <score> <newline> Kevin <score>' or output == 'Draw'
postconditions.description: The output is either None, a string indicating the winner and their score, or 'Draw' if there is no winner.
